rubric_items.reason: All 14 known REQs are traced. The stories' traces together cover REQ-1 to REQ-14 with no gaps, and the intent has no assumed REQs.
Most stories have one outcome each. S-6 puts three separate unchanged constraints in one story: other links (REQ-11), page size (REQ-12) and order (REQ-13).

The ACs use Given/When/Then and cover the boundary cases: the 00:30 IST time-zone case, 21 rows against a page size of 20, the Cancelled exclusion, and start time versus booking order. S-6 AC1/AC2 compare against an unstated earlier behaviour.
Values come from the intent: 20 per page, NOT_CANCELLED and Asia/Kolkata. The UTC+05:30 offset and the 19:00 UTC previous-date instant are worked out inline.
Clear, and uses the glossary terms consistently. Some wording is awkward, for example 'page 1 shows the first 20 per page', and S-4 AC2's Given depends on AC1.

findings.text: S-6 AC2 does not say which filters the dashboard tile should open with. 'Same filters as before this change' can only be checked against an earlier build, so a tester cannot verify it from the story alone.

cites.quote: when staff select it, then the list opens with the same filters as before this change

findings.suggested_fix: Say what the tile's link should set, at least that its status is not changed to NOT_CANCELLED, so the AC catches the Today-link change leaking into the tile.

findings.text: S-6 AC3 is awkwardly worded: 'page 1 shows the first 20 per page'.

cites.quote: then page 1 shows the first 20 per page and the 21st appointment is on page 2

findings.suggested_fix: Reword as 'page 1 shows the first 20 appointments and the 21st is on page 2'.

findings.text: S-4 AC2's Given relies on the setup in AC1 ('the Cancelled appointment', 'that day'), so the AC cannot be read or tested on its own.

cites.quote: Given the Cancelled appointment is the latest-starting appointment of that day

findings.suggested_fix: Restate the full setup in AC2, for example: a doctor's day has a Scheduled appointment and a later-starting Cancelled one.

findings.text: S-6 bundles three separate unchanged constraints (other links, page size, order) into one story, against the one-outcome-per-story rule.
findings.suggested_fix: Either accept S-6 as one regression story or split it into separate stories for links (REQ-11) and for paging and order (REQ-12, REQ-13).
